{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to numeric, handling commas and ensuring proper parsing
# First, replace commas in revenue strings
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)

# Now convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(data['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any conversion errors
conversion_errors = data['revenue_clean'].isna().sum()
print(f"Number of revenue values that could not be converted: {conversion_errors}")

# Verify that the test orders are still absent
internal_test_mask = data['revenue'] == '999999.99'
print(f"Number of internal test orders (original): {internal_test_mask.sum()}")"}
